.work/inventory/spec.md:
# Search and export

**Status:** accepted

The agreed work includes name search and CSV export. All product and architecture decisions are settled. Inputs are already validated.

## Name search

Add search_items(items, query) to src/app.py. Match names by case-insensitive substring in input order. An empty query returns all items. 

## CSV export

Add export_rows(items) to src/app.py. Return CSV text with name,quantity headings, records in input order, standard csv module quoting, and LF line endings. Empty input returns a header-only CSV. File writing and interfaces are excluded. Export is independent of search.

checks/check_search.py:
"""Check the accepted search behavior from the repository root."""
from pathlib import Path
import runpy

source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src/app.py"
search = runpy.run_path(str(source))["search_items"]
rows = [{"name": "Milk", "quantity": 1}, {"name": "Tea", "quantity": 2}, {"name": "Miso", "quantity": 3}]
assert search(rows, "MI") == [rows[0], rows[2]]
assert search(rows, "") == rows
assert search(rows, "unknown") == []
assert search([], "mi") == []
print("Four search checks passed.")
